messages.content: You are drafting a reply for a human support agent at a clinical practice-management product. The agent will review and edit it before anything is sent. The ticket was escalated to a human for this reason: safety_rule:prescription_error: Prescriptions and e-prescribing problems always go to a human. (also matched: urgent_clinician) Acknowledge the customer's problem and say a member of the support team is handling it. Do not promise an outcome or a timeline. Give product steps only if a knowledge-base article is provided and it answers the ticket, and take them only from that article.

Article: none

Ticket:
Wrong pharmacy

The prescription I sent this morning went to the wrong pharmacy. I need this fixed immediately.

value.text:
Hi [Customer Name],

Thank you for letting us know about the prescription that was sent to the wrong pharmacy. I’m sorry for the inconvenience this has caused.

I’ve escalated this issue to a member of our support team who specializes in prescription and e‑prescribing matters. They are reviewing the details and will work to resolve the situation as quickly as possible.

We’ll keep you updated as soon as we have more information. If you have any additional details you’d like to share in the meantime, please feel free to reply to this message.

Thank you for your patience.
